title: Director
subtitle: Director，究竟是哪一種「導演／董事」？
description: Director，究竟是哪一種「導演／董事」？

words.meaning: 電影製作人；電影創作者
words.note: 較廣泛，指參與創作電影的人；在某些語境可泛指導演型創作者，但並不一定只負責導演工作。
words.example: She is an independent filmmaker known for small documentary projects.
words.exampleZh: 她是一位以小型紀錄片項目聞名的獨立電影創作者。

exercises.original: The director is known for making independent documentaries on social issues.
exercises.zh: 這位導演以製作社會議題的獨立紀錄片聞名。
exercises.upgrade: filmmaker · 電影製作人；電影創作者

options.explanation: producer = 製片人可能參與紀錄片，但本句重點是創作影片本身。
actor = 不是表演角色。
filmmaker = 句子把此人描述為製作獨立紀錄片的整體創作者，因此較廣泛的 filmmaker 很自然。
cinematographer = 只負責攝影影像，不涵蓋整體創作。
screenwriter = 不是只寫劇本。
manager = 不合電影創作者語境。

exercises.original: She began her career as a director of short films before moving into television.
exercises.zh: 她以短片導演開始職業生涯，之後轉到電視領域。
exercises.upgrade: filmmaker · 電影製作人；電影創作者

options.explanation: actor = 不是以演出短片開始。
producer = 可能參與製作，但不直接等於 directing short films。
screenwriter = 沒有寫劇本線索。
filmmaker = 從短片創作跨到電視，若不需要強調職位細節，可用較廣的 filmmaker。
cinematographer = 不是只負責鏡頭。
editor = 沒有剪接線索。

exercises.original: The festival invited young directors to present their first films.
exercises.zh: 影展邀請年輕電影創作者展示他們的首部作品。
exercises.upgrade: filmmaker · 電影製作人；電影創作者

options.explanation: actors = 展示自己的 films 不代表演員。
managers = 不合。
board members = 不合。
cinematographers = 只是一種電影職能。
filmmaker = 影展語境中把首次製作作品的年輕創作者統稱 filmmakers 很自然。
screenwriters = 未必擁有整部作品。

words.note: 最直接、最精確的說法之一，指負責電影創作方向、演員表演和拍攝決策的人。
words.example: The film director asked the actors to repeat the scene.
words.exampleZh: 電影導演要求演員重拍這一幕。

exercises.original: The director asked the actors to repeat the scene with less emotion.
exercises.zh: 導演要求演員以較少情緒重拍這一幕。

options.explanation: producer = 通常不是指導演員表演的人。
screenwriter = 不負責現場 directing actors。
cinematographer = 負責攝影畫面，不主要決定演員表演。
film director = actors + repeat the scene 是電影拍攝現場導演工作的直接線索，因此 film director 最精確。
actor = 是被指導的人。
editor = 主要在後期剪接。

exercises.original: The director worked with the cinematographer to plan every shot.
exercises.zh: 導演與攝影指導合作規劃每個鏡頭。

options.explanation: producer = 可參與整體製作，但與 cinematographer 規劃每個 shot 更屬導演工作。
screenwriter = 不負責 shot planning。
actor = 不合。
production manager = 主要管理日程和物流。
film director = 和 cinematographer 一起規劃 shots，正是 film director 的典型職責。
composer = 負責音樂。

exercises.original: After reading the script, the director changed the way the final scene would be filmed.
exercises.zh: 讀過劇本後，導演修改了最後一幕的拍攝方式。

options.explanation: screenwriter = 編劇可改 script，但這裡改的是 how the scene would be filmed。
producer = 不主要負責鏡頭詮釋。
actor = 不合。
editor = final scene 尚未拍攝。
cinematographer = 會參與拍法，但整體創作決定通常由 director 領導。
film director = 決定劇本如何被拍成影像，是 film director 的核心職能。

words.note: 和 film director 意思相近，較常見於美式和較口語語境。
words.example: The movie director changed the ending during production.
words.exampleZh: 電影導演在製作期間修改了結局。

exercises.original: The director became famous after his first Hollywood feature film.
exercises.zh: 這位電影導演在首部荷里活長片後成名。

options.explanation: stage director = Hollywood feature film 不是舞台作品。
producer = 製片人不是同一職責。
actor = 不合。
artistic director = 通常管理藝術機構或季目。
movie director = Hollywood feature film 明確是電影語境，較口語的美式說法 movie director 很自然。
board member = 不合。

exercises.original: The movie's director discussed the ending in an interview.
exercises.zh: 這部電影的導演在訪問中談到結局。

options.explanation: producer = 也可能受訪，但 movie's director 是特定創作職位。
screenwriter = 可能寫 ending，但不等於導演。
actor = 不合。
stage director = 媒介錯誤。
manager = 不合。
movie director = 談的是一部 movie 的導演，因此 movie director 是最直接替換。

exercises.original: The director won an award for the way the movie handled its final scene.
exercises.zh: 導演因電影處理最後一幕的方式而獲獎。

options.explanation: movie director = 獎項針對整部 movie 的導演處理方式，因此 movie director 最精確。
producer = 不一定負責 scene 的創作處理。
actor = 不是整部電影處理方式。
cinematographer = 只負責影像的一部分。
screenwriter = 不是整體 directing。
executive director = 是組織管理職位。

words.note: 指負責戲劇、音樂劇或其他現場舞台演出的導演。
words.example: The stage director adjusted the actors' positions before rehearsal.
words.exampleZh: 舞台導演在排練前調整演員位置。

exercises.original: The director moved the actors farther apart before the next rehearsal.
exercises.zh: 導演在下一次排練前讓演員站得更開。

options.explanation: film director = rehearsal 可以出現於電影，但演員舞台站位更符合 stage context。
producer = 不主要安排演員站位。
playwright = 負責劇本。
actor = 不是指導整體走位的人。
stage manager = 通常執行和協調，不作主要藝術決定。
stage director = rehearsal + actors' positions 是舞台走位指導，因此 stage director 最自然。

exercises.original: The director asked the cast to enter from the opposite side of the stage.
exercises.zh: 導演要求演員從舞台另一側進場。

options.explanation: stage director = cast + side of the stage 是舞台演出線索，因此 stage director 最精確。
producer = 不負責舞台走位藝術決定。
film director = 句子明確說 stage。
playwright = 不主要指導演出。
costume designer = 不合。
stage manager = 通常執行 blocking，但藝術決定由 stage director 主導。

exercises.original: During rehearsal, the director worked on the timing of the actors' entrances.
exercises.zh: 排練期間，導演調整演員進場時間。

options.explanation: screenwriter = 不負責排練 timing。
stage director = rehearsal 中處理 entrances timing 是典型舞台導演工作。
producer = 不合。
cinematographer = 不合 theatre。
actor = 只負責自身表演。
company director = 是企業職位。

words.note: 和 stage director 很接近，常指統籌戲劇作品整體藝術方向和演出的導演。
words.example: The theatre director chose a modern interpretation of the play.
words.exampleZh: 劇場導演為這齣戲選擇了現代化詮釋。

exercises.original: The director chose a modern interpretation of the Shakespeare play.
exercises.zh: 導演為莎士比亞戲劇選擇了現代化詮釋。
exercises.upgrade: theatre director · 劇場導演；戲劇導演

options.explanation: theatre director = Shakespeare play + interpretation 指向戲劇作品整體藝術詮釋，因此 theatre director 最準確。
film director = 句子是 play，不是電影。
producer = 不主要負責劇本藝術詮釋。
playwright = 當前人物負責詮釋，不是寫劇本。
stage manager = 不主導整體 interpretation。
actor = 不合。

exercises.original: The director worked with the designers to create a minimalist production of the play.
exercises.zh: 導演與設計師合作，製作一個極簡風格的戲劇版本。
exercises.upgrade: theatre director · 劇場導演；戲劇導演

options.explanation: producer = 可能管理資源，但 aesthetic production concept 由 theatre director 主導。
theatre director = production of the play + designers 的整體風格協作，典型是 theatre director。
screenwriter = 不合舞台劇製作。
actor = 不合。
managing director = 是管理職。
cinematographer = 不合 theatre。

exercises.original: The director explained her interpretation of the play to the cast before rehearsals began.
exercises.zh: 排練開始前，導演向演員解釋她對劇本的詮釋。
exercises.upgrade: theatre director · 劇場導演；戲劇導演

options.explanation: playwright = 不是原作者在寫劇本。
producer = 不合藝術詮釋。
theatre director = 對整齣 play 的 interpretation 並向 cast 傳達，是 theatre director 的核心工作。
stage manager = 不主導 interpretation。
actor = 不是向整個 cast 統一說明的人。
creative director = 通常不是戲劇排練的標準職稱。

words.note: 指負責電視節目、劇集或現場電視製作的導演。
words.example: The television director coordinated the cameras during the live broadcast.
words.exampleZh: 電視導演在直播期間協調多部攝影機。

exercises.original: The director coordinated several cameras during the live broadcast.
exercises.zh: 導演在直播期間協調多部攝影機。

options.explanation: film director = live broadcast 更典型屬 television production。
television director = live broadcast + several cameras 是電視導演工作的直接線索。
producer = 可能統籌節目，但不主要叫多機位切換和鏡頭。
screenwriter = 不合直播。
actor = 不合。
board member = 不合。

exercises.original: The director told camera two to move in for a close-up.
exercises.zh: 導演要求二號攝影機推近拍特寫。

options.explanation: producer = 不主要即時指揮 camera two。
actor = 不合。
television director = 即時指揮指定攝影機拍 close-up，最典型是 television director。
editor = live context 不依賴後期剪接。
screenwriter = 不合。
stage director = 不負責電視攝影機鏡頭。

exercises.original: The director rehearsed the timing of the live news segment before it went on air.
exercises.zh: 直播新聞環節出街前，導演排練了整段時間安排。

options.explanation: film director = went on air 是電視語境。
producer = 可管節目流程，但 directing live segment timing 更像 TV director。
actor = 不合。
television director = live news segment + went on air 明確是電視製作，因此 television director 最精確。
company director = 不合。
cinematographer = 不是直播整體 timing 負責人。

words.note: 通常指劇團、舞團、藝術節或文化機構中負責整體藝術方向的人。
words.example: The artistic director selected the productions for next season.
words.exampleZh: 藝術總監選定了下一季的演出作品。

exercises.original: The director selected the theatre company's productions for next season.
exercises.zh: 藝術總監選定劇團下一季的演出作品。
exercises.upgrade: artistic director · 藝術總監；藝術指導

options.explanation: stage director = 通常負責某一齣作品，不一定決定整季 repertoire。
producer = 不一定掌握整體藝術季方向。
artistic director = theatre company's productions for next season 是整體藝術規劃，因此 artistic director 最準確。
managing director = 偏營運管理。
actor = 不合。
screenwriter = 不合。

exercises.original: The director is responsible for the festival's overall artistic vision.
exercises.zh: 藝術總監負責整個藝術節的藝術方向。
exercises.upgrade: artistic director · 藝術總監；藝術指導

options.explanation: executive director = 可能負責行政營運，但 artistic vision 明確屬藝術總監。
stage director = 範圍通常只是一個 production。
producer = 不合整個 festival artistic vision。
artistic director = overall artistic vision 是 artistic director 的直接職責描述。
board member = 不合。
manager = 太泛。

exercises.original: The director invited three new choreographers to develop work for the dance company.
exercises.zh: 藝術總監邀請三名新編舞家為舞團創作作品。
exercises.upgrade: artistic director · 藝術總監；藝術指導

options.explanation: stage director = 不一定管理整個 dance company repertoire。
producer = 不主要設定舞團藝術方向。
executive director = 偏營運。
actor = 不合。
artistic director = 為 dance company 邀請創作者、塑造整體藝術方向，典型是 artistic director。
screenwriter = 不合。

words.note: 常見於廣告、設計、時裝和品牌領域，負責整體創意方向和視覺概念。
words.example: The creative director approved the final campaign concept.
words.exampleZh: 創意總監批准了最終宣傳概念。

exercises.original: The director approved the visual concept for the advertising campaign.
exercises.zh: 創意總監批准了廣告活動的視覺概念。

options.explanation: film director = 不是電影拍攝。
producer = 不是廣告整體 creative concept 的標準職稱。
artistic director = 較常用於表演藝術機構。
creative director = visual concept + advertising campaign 是 creative director 的典型語境。
managing director = 偏公司管理。
board member = 不合。

exercises.original: The agency's director reviewed the copy, photography, and layout together.
exercises.zh: 廣告公司的創意總監一併審閱文案、攝影和版面設計。

options.explanation: film director = 不合 agency campaign。
account manager = 負責客戶和專案，不主導全部 creative output。
producer = 可能協調製作，但不一定統領 copy/layout 概念。
company director = 太泛。
creative director = 同時統籌 copy、photography、layout 的整體創意一致性，最符合 creative director。
actor = 不合。

exercises.original: The director asked the design team to make the brand identity more consistent.
exercises.zh: 創意總監要求設計團隊令品牌形象更一致。

options.explanation: artistic director = 品牌和 design team 語境更常用 creative director。
managing director = 未必直接主導品牌視覺。
producer = 不合。
stage director = 不合。
screenwriter = 不合。
creative director = design team + brand identity 明確屬創意與品牌管理，因此 creative director 最自然。

words.note: 常見於非牟利機構、協會和組織，指負責日常營運和高層管理的人。
words.example: The executive director presented the annual plan to the board.
words.exampleZh: 執行董事向董事會提交年度計劃。

exercises.original: The director presented the nonprofit organization's annual budget to the board.
exercises.zh: 執行董事向董事會提交非牟利機構年度預算。
exercises.upgrade: executive director · 執行董事；行政總監

options.explanation: artistic director = 若是 artistic director，重點應是藝術內容而非年度預算。
film director = 不合。
stage director = 不合。
board member = 是聽取／審批的一方之一，不一定負責提交整體預算。
executive director = nonprofit organization + annual budget + board 是 executive director 的典型管理語境。
producer = 不合非牟利機構管理。

exercises.original: The director oversees daily operations and reports directly to the board.
exercises.zh: 執行董事監督日常營運，並直接向董事會匯報。
exercises.upgrade: executive director · 執行董事；行政總監

options.explanation: artistic director = 核心職責不是 daily operations。
company director = 可能是董事，但 reports directly to the board 更像 executive director 職能。
stage director = 不合。
producer = 不合。
actor = 不合。
executive director = oversees daily operations 並向 board 匯報，最精確是 executive director。

exercises.original: The charity's director approved the hiring plan for the coming year.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構的執行董事批准來年的招聘計劃。
exercises.upgrade: executive director · 執行董事；行政總監

options.explanation: executive director = charity 的高層行政和 hiring plan 屬 executive director 管理範圍。
creative director = 不負責整體 charity hiring。
film director = 不合。
artistic director = 未必掌管全機構人事。
board member = 單一 board member 通常不直接批准日常招聘計劃。
producer = 不合。

words.note: 英式商業語境常見，指公司最高層管理人員之一，通常負責整體業務運作。
words.example: The managing director announced a new expansion strategy.
words.exampleZh: 董事總經理宣布新的擴展策略。

exercises.original: The director announced the company's new expansion strategy.
exercises.zh: 董事總經理宣布公司的新擴展策略。
exercises.upgrade: managing director · 董事總經理；總經理

options.explanation: creative director = 不負責公司整體 expansion strategy。
artistic director = 不合商業。
film director = 不合。
board member = 可能支持策略，但不一定是負責公布和營運的人。
producer = 不合。
managing director = 公司整體 expansion strategy 是最高層商業管理語境，因此 managing director 最自然。

exercises.original: The director is responsible for the company's overall performance in the UK.
exercises.zh: 董事總經理負責公司在英國的整體表現。
exercises.upgrade: managing director · 董事總經理；總經理

options.explanation: managing director = overall performance of the company 指向全面營運責任，因此 managing director 最精確。
department manager = 範圍通常只是一個部門。
creative director = 只管創意方向。
company director = 較泛，未必負責 overall performance。
board member = 未必參與日常經營。
producer = 不合。

exercises.original: The director met senior managers to review quarterly sales and costs.
exercises.zh: 董事總經理與高級經理會面，檢視季度銷售和成本。
exercises.upgrade: managing director · 董事總經理；總經理

options.explanation: creative director = 不主要審視整體 sales and costs。
managing director = 和 senior managers 檢討季度業務數據，典型是 managing director。
artistic director = 不合。
film director = 不合。
board member = 可關注數字，但此處像日常高層營運會議。
actor = 不合。

words.note: 指依法或正式擔任公司董事會職位、參與公司重大決策的人。
words.example: Every company director must understand their legal responsibilities.
words.exampleZh: 每名公司董事都必須了解自己的法律責任。

exercises.original: Every director must understand the legal duties attached to the role.
exercises.zh: 每名公司董事都必須了解該職位附帶的法律責任。

options.explanation: company director = legal duties attached to the role 是公司董事的法定治理語境，因此 company director 最精確。
manager = 經理不一定承擔董事法定責任。
executive director = 只是 director 的一種。
producer = 不合。
creative director = 不是公司法上的 director 必然含義。
actor = 不合。

exercises.original: The company's directors approved the acquisition at a formal meeting.
exercises.zh: 公司董事在正式會議上批准收購。

options.explanation: managers = 經理通常無權作出董事會層級 acquisition approval。
company director = formal meeting 中批准 acquisition 是公司董事的治理職責，因此 company directors 最自然。
producers = 不合。
stage directors = 不合。
creative directors = 不合。
employees = 權限太低。

exercises.original: She was appointed a director of the company last year.
exercises.zh: 她去年獲委任為公司董事。

options.explanation: manager = appointed manager 和法定 director 職位不同。
board assistant = 不是董事。
company director = appointed ... of the company 明確是公司治理職位，因此 company director 最直接。
producer = 不合。
artistic director = 不合。
screenwriter = 不合。

words.note: 當 director 指公司或機構董事會中的一名成員時，可用 board member；但並非所有 board members 在所有制度下都稱 director。
words.example: The board member voted in favour of the proposed merger.
words.exampleZh: 這名董事會成員投票支持擬議合併。

exercises.original: As a director, he attends board meetings and votes on major decisions.
exercises.zh: 身為董事會成員，他出席董事會會議並就重大決策投票。
exercises.upgrade: board member · 董事會成員；理事

options.explanation: manager = 經理未必有 board vote。
board member = attends board meetings + votes 是 board membership 的直接線索，因此 board member 最自然。
executive director = 可能兼任 board member，但本句重點是董事會身份。
producer = 不合。
creative director = 不合。
employee = 普通員工沒有此治理權限。

exercises.original: The directors discussed the proposed merger before voting.
exercises.zh: 董事會成員在投票前討論擬議合併。
exercises.upgrade: board member · 董事會成員；理事

options.explanation: managers = 不是所有 managers 都有 merger vote。
employees = 不合治理職責。
board member = 能在 merger 上正式 voting 的是 board members，因此此處很精確。
producers = 不合。
stage directors = 不合。
department heads = 未必是董事會成員。

exercises.original: Each director receives papers before the quarterly board meeting.
exercises.zh: 每名董事會成員在季度董事會會議前都會收到會議文件。
exercises.upgrade: board member · 董事會成員；理事

options.explanation: manager = 未必參加 board meeting。
producer = 不合。
actor = 不合。
board member = quarterly board meeting + meeting papers 明確指董事會成員身份。
creative director = 除非同時是 board member，否則不一定收到董事會文件。
employee = 不合。

words.note: 和 director 同屬影視製作核心角色，但通常不是同義詞。製片人多負責資金、資源、進度和製作管理；只有在同一人兼任 producer-director 時才可指同一個人。
words.example: The producer worked closely with the director to keep the film on schedule.
words.exampleZh: 製片人和導演緊密合作，確保電影按進度完成。

exercises.original: The producer worked closely with the director to keep the film within budget.
exercises.zh: 製片人和導演緊密合作，確保電影不超出預算。

options.explanation: actor = 不主要負責 budget。
screenwriter = 不主要管理整體製作預算。
producer = 這一題特別顯示 producer 和 director 是不同角色：producer 更偏 budget 和 production management。
cinematographer = 不主要負責 financing。
stage director = 媒介和職責不合。
editor = 主要負責後期剪接。

exercises.original: The director secured financing and hired the production team before filming began.
exercises.zh: 這位製片人取得資金並聘請製作團隊，然後才開始拍攝。

options.explanation: film director = 導演可參與選人，但 securing financing 和 hiring production team 更偏 producer。
actor = 不合。
screenwriter = 不合。
producer = secured financing + hired the production team 是製片人的典型職責，因此這裡應用 producer；它不是一般情況下的 director 同義詞。
cinematographer = 不合。
stage director = 不合。

exercises.original: She served as both director and producer on the independent film.
exercises.zh: 她在這部獨立電影中同時擔任導演和製片人。

options.explanation: actor = 不是這兩個職位之一。
screenwriter = 句子沒有說她寫劇本。
cinematographer = 沒有攝影職責線索。
manager = 太泛。
producer = both director and producer 明確證明兩個職位可由同一人兼任，但不是同義詞；這是最重要的辨析。
board member = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 製片人通常不等於導演 producer 主要統籌資金、資源和製作流程；director 主要負責創作和演出方向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The producer manages production; the director leads the creative interpretation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 演員不等於導演 actor 負責表演角色；director 指導演員和整體作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Actors perform the roles; the director guides the performance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 編劇不等於導演 screenwriter 負責寫劇本；director 負責把劇本轉化成影像和演出。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The screenwriter writes the script; the director interprets it for the screen.

falseSynonyms.zh: 攝影指導不等於導演 cinematographer 主要負責影像、燈光和攝影技術；director 負責整體創作方向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cinematographer shapes the image; the director shapes the overall production.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經理不一定等於 director manager 通常負責某一部門或日常管理；director 往往層級更高或職責不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A manager may report to a director, depending on the organization.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與名詞不同 direct 是動詞；director 是執行導演或管理職能的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She directs films. She is a film director.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方向／指導與職位不同 direction 可指方向、指導或創作方向；director 是人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The director gave clear direction to the actors.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 directorial 是形容詞，表示與導演工作有關；director 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The film shows a distinctive directorial style. Its director is well known.
